6.2.1 Large Data Path in COM
AUTOSAR defines an alternative communication path between the RTE and the Com-
munication Stack called Large Data Path in COM. The System Template does not
define specific attributes which would distinguish whether the traditional Com or the
Large Data Path in COM shall be used. The idea behind this feature is rather that
• IF the Large Data Path in COM module is enabled in an Ecu
System Template
• AND the specific interaction fulfills certain properties
• THEN Large Data Path in COM shall be used.
Thus the usage of Large Data Path in COM inside an ECU is project specific and is not
derived from system description properties.
All of the following requirements need to be fulfilled in order to allow the usage of Large
Data Path in COM for the specific ISignal / ISignalIPdu combination.
[TPS_SYST_02015] Large Data Path in COM: only one ISignal mapped to the
ISignalIPdu ⌈Only if exactly one ISignal is mapped into an ISignalIPdu and
Large Data Path in COM is enabled, this ISignal shall be handled by Large Data
Path in COM.⌋
[TPS_SYST_02016]
Large Data Path in COM: only Transformer output and
UINT8_N or UINT8_DYN supported ⌈Only if
• the data type of the ISignal is either UINT8_N or UINT8_DYN
• or the ISignal has a reference to the DataTransformation in the role data-
Transformation
and Large Data Path in COM is enabled, this ISignal shall be handled by Large Data
Path in COM.⌋
[TPS_SYST_02017] Large Data Path in COM: Opaque ISignalToIPduMapping.
